description:
## Problem
BenchBox has none of the specification's audit, batch-validation or visibility SQL, and no TPC-DI licence files. The files are in TPC's tools download, which is behind a request form.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- "Ship them in BenchBox under EULA clause 9 (include the EULA and the required legend, charge no fee)." and "Proceed on the reviewer's reading of clause 9; no gate."
- "The legend 'THE TPC SOFTWARE IS AVAILABLE WITHOUT CHARGE FROM TPC.' is line 1 of a NOTICE.txt beside the shipped TPC-DI files and appears in the README's licence section."
- "The TPC audit SQL is shipped unmodified. Only the specification's permitted minor substitutions are applied at run time, each recorded in the bundle. A platform that needs more than that stops and asks you."
- DIGen and PDGF are NOT shipped (PDGF licence forbids redistribution).

## Change
Plan S6 without DIGen. Add _sources/tpc-di/ and benchbox/_binaries/tpc-di/ with EULA.txt (byte-identical to the archive's), NOTICE.txt (legend on line 1) and the unmodified tpcdi_audit.sql, tpcdi_validation.sql, tpcdi_visibility_1.sql, tpcdi_visibility_2.sql; SHA256MANIFEST, MANIFEST.in and comment-policy external entries; a TPC-DI section in _sources/README.md with archive name and SHA-256; README licence section; extend tests/unit/core/test_tpc_notices.py. Add an appendix SQL loader that applies only the substitutions the specification permits (3.4.11.1.1) at run time and returns the list applied.

## Clean-room rule (owner: "Strict clean room: the implementer reads only the specification, the paper and the TPC appendix SQL.")
The implementer reads only the TPC-DI v1.1.0 specification, the VLDB 2014 paper (Poess, Rabl, Jacobsen, Caufield) and the TPC appendix SQL. It never opens PDGF configuration or dictionaries, DIGen or PDGF source or decompiled classes, the `tpc-di_src.jar` plugin source, or `shannon-barrow/databricks-tpc-di`'s `tpcdi_gen`. Subagents get the same rule in their brief. The pull request description states that the rule was followed.

## Decision gates
Owner action first: the owner places the official archive at ~/Developer/tpc-tools/TPC-DI_Tools_v1.1.0.zip and the item stays blocked until it is there. The implementer extracts only the EULA and the four appendix SQL files and opens nothing else in the archive (clean-room rule: no PDGF, no DIGen source). If the archive lacks any of the four files, or its EULA differs from _sources/tpc-h/EULA.txt in a way that affects clause 9, stop and report. The zip is never committed.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the four SQL files and EULA in the wheel equal the archive members byte for byte (SHA-256 in the pull request); line 1 of NOTICE.txt equals the legend; `uv build --wheel && unzip -l dist/benchbox-*.whl | rg 'tpc-di/'` lists them; the notices test passes and fails if the legend is removed; loader tests show the recorded substitutions and that the stored files are untouched; `make comment-policy-check` and `make pr-preflight` pass.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
